get.description: Public (no login). Active doctors of active polis, optionally of one poli. No license or account data is exposed.

post.description: Public (no login). Creates a patient record with the same fields and validation as the front desk (NIK must be a valid, unused 16-digit number; bpjs_number optional). Returns the brief patient (id and No. RM) to pass to POST /apm/visits. An existing NIK or BPJS number is refused with 409: that person is a returning patient and should be looked up instead. Strictly rate limited per IP (5 per minute).

get.description: Public (no login), for the self-service registration kiosk (APM). Send exactly one of nik, medical_record_number (RM-000001) or bpjs_number. Returns only what the kiosk needs to confirm the person (no NIK, contact, address or allergies). Strictly rate limited per IP (10 per minute).
Public (no login). Active polis only, with only the fields a kiosk shows.

Public (no login). Today's practice hours and remaining quota of the doctors with a weekly schedule, optionally of one poli. A doctor on leave has status "leave"; a doctor without a session today is absent. Only today can be asked. Rate limited per IP.

post.description: Public (no login). Registers a patient (patient_id from the lookup, or from POST /apm/patients for a new patient) for a visit today with an active doctor of the chosen poli, following the same rules as the front desk (BPJS and insurance fields, responsible person under 18, no double registration). The kiosk cannot pick another date or approve the visit. Returns the ticket to print. Rate limited per IP (60 per minute).

post.summary: Sign in with NIP or email

post.description: Open for the very first account (becomes superadmin). Afterwards only a superadmin can register accounts. For role doctor, doctor_id (an active doctor from GET /doctors?has_account=false, one account per doctor) is required; for other roles it is rejected.

get.description: Front office and superadmin. One row per active doctor and date from the weekly schedules: practice hours, total quota, registered visits and what is left. Defaults to 7 days from today; a period spans at most 31 days. A "leave" row has no quota; a "substitute" row counts the visits of the doctor on leave. Registration (POST /visits) refuses a doctor without a session, on leave, or with no quota left.

parameters.description: Last date (YYYY-MM-DD), default 6 days after from
parameters.name: to

get.description: Cashier only. Finalized and paid bills, most recent first. Search by patient name, medical record number, invoice or receipt number.

parameters.description: Search by patient, medical record, invoice or receipt number
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Only final (awaiting payment) or paid bills
parameters.name: status

get.description: Cashier only. Every visit of the date that is not cancelled, with its bill status and totals; a visit with nothing billed yet is a draft priced from its registration and doctor. visit.visit_status tells ready to bill (Completed) from still at the clinic (Registered, Served) and paid (Paid).
Cashier only. While draft, the lines and totals are provisional; a final bill's lines are frozen.

put.description: Cashier only, draft bills only. A discount needs a reason of at least 15 characters and cannot exceed the subtotal; amount 0 removes it. Recorded in the bill's audit trail.

post.description: Cashier only, and only once the visit is Completed (the doctor finalized the SOAP note). Freezes the lines and issues the invoice number (INV/YYYYMMDD/NNNN).
Cashier only, draft bills only. Adds a line under "other"; it needs a reason of at least 15 characters. Recorded in the bill's audit trail.

Cashier only, final bills only. The payments must cover the remaining patient portion, which the server recomputes; each part is capped to what is left, and cash change is computed from received. Send no payments when the patient portion is 0. Issues the receipt number (KW/YYYYMMDD/NNNN), records the payments in the cashier's open shift (opening one if needed), and moves the visit to Paid.
Cashier only, for finalized or paid bills. Records that the invoice was printed or saved as PDF, in the bill's audit trail.

put.description: Cashier only, draft bills only. Sets who pays: umum (the patient), bpjs (the patient pays only the class-upgrade excess) or asuransi (the insurer pays up to the coverage limit). Recorded in the bill's audit trail.

get.description: Cashier and management. Shifts opened on the date, newest first, each with what it received per payment method; for today, shifts still open from earlier are included.
Cashier only. The signed-in cashier's open shift, or data null when none is open. A shift opens with the first payment and again right after the previous one is closed.

post.description: Cashier only, for the cashier's own open shift. Records the counted cash and locks the shift's total; a note of at least 10 characters is required when the count differs from the recorded cash. The cashier's next shift opens right away.

get.description: Front Office only. Each counter comes with the queue it is handling right now (or null).

post.description: Front Office only. A CALLING or SERVING queue becomes COMPLETED and the counter is free again.
Front Office only. Gives the oldest waiting queue of today to this counter (status CALLING). Concurrent counters never receive the same queue.
Front Office only. Refreshes last_called_at and call_count of the counter's CALLING queue so displays ring the bell again.
Front Office only. The called patient is present: CALLING becomes SERVING.
Front Office only. The called patient did not show up: CALLING becomes SKIPPED and the counter is free again.

patch.description: Front Office only. A counter that is handling a queue cannot be deactivated.

get.description: Public (no login) so TV screens can poll it. Shows only queue numbers and counters, never patient data. A changed last_called_at means the bell should ring again.

post.description: Superadmin only. The poli must exist and be active. SIP, STR and IHS numbers must be unique; ihs_number is optional. The poli's doctor count is updated automatically.

get.description: Any signed-in user.

put.description: Superadmin only. Replaces all editable fields; a missing is_active keeps the current status. Moving a doctor to another poli updates both polis' doctor counts. The new poli must be active.

delete.description: Superadmin only. A doctor that a user account or a visit refers to cannot be deleted (409); deactivate the doctor instead. The poli's doctor count is updated automatically.

get.description: Doctor only. The signed-in doctor's visits of one date (default today) in poli queue order, cancelled visits excluded. Each row tells whether vital signs exist and the SOAP note status.

parameters.description: Search by patient name or medical record number
parameters.name: search

get.description: Doctor only, and only for visits assigned to the signed-in doctor. Returns the visit summary, values to prefill the form from, the vital signs, and the SOAP note (each null until saved).

post.description: Doctor only (own visits, today only). Calls a patient who is waiting, already called or skipped; the examination must not have started. Sets poli_queue_status to Called, records the call time and counts the call.

Doctor only (own visits). Needs a started examination and a finalized SOAP note (409 otherwise); discharge_method follow_up also needs a control_date in the note. Moves the visit to Completed and poli_queue_status to Done, and records the discharge condition and method.

get.description: Doctor only, opened from one of the doctor's own visits. Lists the patient's other visits (any poli and doctor, cancelled ones excluded), newest first. The SOAP note is included only once finalized; attachments are listed by name (downloads stay limited to the visit's own doctor).

post.description: Doctor only (own visits, today only). Repeats the call of a patient whose poli_queue_status is Called.
Doctor only (own visits, today only). Marks a waiting or called patient as Skipped; they can be called again later.

get.description: Doctor only (own visits). Objective.vital_signs is pulled in automatically: live values while the note is a draft, the frozen snapshot once final. 404 until a draft has been saved.

put.description: Doctor only (own visits). Creates the draft on the first call (version 0) and replaces it afterwards (send the current version, otherwise 409). Needs a started examination (POST /start). Diagnoses are ICD-10 codes (format only; no code list is checked yet): one primary, up to 10 secondary. control_date only goes with outpatient_followup, referral_notes only with refer_inpatient or refer_icu. Not allowed once final.

post.description: Doctor only (own visits). Appends a correction or note to a finalized SOAP note. Addenda cannot be edited or deleted.

Doctor only (own visits). Needs the vital signs, subjective, plan, a primary diagnosis and a follow-up (plus control_date or referral_notes where they apply), otherwise 422 with the missing fields. Needs a started examination. Freezes the vital signs shown in the objective part and locks the note and the vital signs; the visit stays Served until it is closed (POST /close). Corrections afterwards go through addenda.
Doctor only (own visits, today only). Moves the visit from Registered to Served and poli_queue_status to Examining. The SOAP note can only be written after this.

get.description: Doctor only (own visits). 404 until the vital signs have been saved.

put.description: Doctor only (own visits). Creates the record on the first call (version 0). Every later change creates a new version in the history and needs a change_reason (and the current version, otherwise 409); a request that changes nothing is rejected. BMI and its Kemenkes RI category are computed by the server (category is not_applicable under 18 years); flags are advisory. Not allowed once the SOAP note is final, for cancelled visits, or for visits scheduled for a later date. Either list allergies or set no_known_allergies.
put.summary: Save the vital signs and initial assessment

get.description: Doctor only (own visits). Every saved version, newest first, with the reason, who made it, when, and which fields differ from the version before. 404 until the vital signs have been saved.
Doctor only (own visits). The vital signs exactly as they were in that version, plus the reason and the fields that changed.
get.summary: Get one version of the vital signs

get.description: Uploaded files of one record, oldest first. Pending and rejected uploads are not listed.
get.summary: List the files of a record

parameters.description: Record ID (for soap_note: the visit ID)
parameters.name: resource_id

post.description: Step 1 of 3. Checks that the caller may attach files to the record (resource_type + resource_id, e.g. soap_note + the visit ID), registers a pending file and returns a presigned URL. Step 2: the client sends the file bytes straight to storage with an HTTP PUT to that URL, using the returned headers (the API never carries the bytes). Step 3: call POST /files/{id}/complete. The URL expires after 15 minutes. Content type, size and number of files are limited per resource type.

delete.description: Removes the file from the record. Allowed only while the record can still be changed (e.g. a SOAP note that is not final). Verified files stay in storage for the record's history.

post.description: Step 3 of 3. Call after the PUT to storage succeeded. The server checks the stored object: its size must equal size_bytes and its real content (not just the declared type) must match content_type. A file that fails is deleted from storage and rejected (422). Only then does the file become available.

get.description: Returns a presigned URL (valid for 5 minutes) the client opens to download the file. The access check happens here, so keep the URL private.

post.description: Superadmin only. Closes the doctor's session on a date (today or later) and optionally hands it to a substitute doctor. The doctor must have a schedule on that date, unless a substitute is given: a substitute can also cover a doctor who has no session that day. A substitute must be a different, active doctor who practices on that weekday and is not on leave that day. When visits are already registered, a substitute is required (409). Visits are not moved or cancelled; the substitute's session counts them against its quota.

get.description: Superadmin only. Weekly templates ordered Monday to Sunday. min_quota is the highest number of registered visits on that weekday over the next 30 days; the total quota cannot go below it.

post.description: Superadmin only. Creates the weekly template of one doctor for one weekday (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday). The total quota is jkn_quota + non_jkn_quota and must be at least 1. Times use HH:MM and the end must be after the start. effective_date cannot be in the past. A doctor has at most one template per weekday.

get.description: Superadmin only. Leave exceptions ordered by date, optionally for one doctor and a date range.

post.description: Superadmin only. Closes the doctor's session on a date (today or later) and optionally hands it to a substitute doctor. The doctor must have a schedule on that date. A substitute must be a different, active doctor who practices on that weekday and is not on leave that day. When visits are already registered, a substitute is required (409). Visits are not moved or cancelled; the substitute's session counts them against its quota.

delete.description: Superadmin only. Reopens the doctor's session. Only today's and future exceptions can be cancelled (400 for past ones).

get.description: Superadmin only. The doctor's sessions per date, derived from the weekly schedule and leaves (nothing is stored). Defaults to the next 30 days from today; a period can span at most 31 days. A leave gives a "leave" row with zero quota, plus a "substitute" row when another doctor takes over; the substitute row counts the visits of both doctors. filled is the number of non-cancelled visits, so every registration channel shares one quota.

parameters.description: Last date (YYYY-MM-DD), default 29 days after from

get.description: Superadmin only.

put.description: Superadmin only. Replaces times, quotas and effective date; the doctor and weekday cannot change. The total quota cannot be lower than the visits already registered on that weekday in the next 30 days (409); existing visits are never cancelled.

delete.description: Superadmin only. A schedule with visits registered on that weekday in the next 30 days cannot be deleted (409).
